events.title: The Endgame Reveal
events.summary: The demo stops right when things get interesting.In the full game, your journey doesn't stop after one prestige. As you get closer to 100% morality, the game transforms.The challenge shifts from "how do I grow?" to "how should I sustain this monster I've created?". Plus things get a little wild!Only 1 month to go until launch!

events.title: Demo Update

events.summary: At its heart, Tube2K is a incremental game... but it’s also a moral test.As your platform hits millions of views, you'll face decisions that have real-world consequences. Do you:Fact-check content (losing views but gaining trust)?Or let conspiracy theories run wild to boost engagement (and ad revenue)?These aren't cosmetic choices. events.title: Why 2005?
events.summary: Tube2K isn't just a incremental game – it’s a time machine.I chose 2005 as the setting because it was the wild west of the internet. Broadband was spreading, flash videos were king, and nobody knew what a "content creator" was yet.In the game, you're stepping into that chaos. No playbook, no algorithm gods to copy—just you, your servers, and a blank canvas.This isn't just about making money. It's about shaping internet culture from the ground up. events.title: Introducing Buggy!
events.summary: Any good Operating System needs a cheesy helper to guide you on you way. So with that said say hello to Buggy!Buggy is your little helper at the start of Tube2K to let you know some basics. But don't worry he doesn't pester you like Clippy. Once he's dropped his knowledge bombs on you he's gone... Unless you really like him and want to see more of him. Let me know in the comments and that can be arranged ;)

events.title: You Make The Difference
events.summary: I want to say a huge thanks to the community. Many of your suggestions have already made it into the full version's development.If you've played the demo and enjoyed it, it would mean the world to me if you could drop a quick review on the store page. It really helps other players discover Tube2K.For new players: The demo is completely free and gives you a solid chunk of gameplay. Go give it a whirl!

events.title: Tube2K Announcement
events.summary: Hi everyone,I'm excited to finally share some info about Tube2K.Tube2K is an incremental game inspired by the early 2000s internet era, a time when websites were chaotic, online videos were unpredictable, and nobody quite knew what the future of the internet was going to look like.
